title: What $295 million in city bonds would build
subtitle: Proposition A covers parks; Proposition B splits between two library branches
alt: Bar chart of the two City of Austin bond propositions on the November 3 ballot, as reported by Community Impact: Proposition A, $260 million for park improvements and expansions; Proposition B, $20 million to improve and expand the Hampton Branch at Oak Hill and $15 million for a future branch in Colony Park.
